[[Kantoh's Walking Stick]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Admiral Kantoh]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Jahai Bluffs]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]])
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge of spells]] (Chance: 20%)
:[[HCT|Halves casting time of spells]] (Chance: 10%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Enchantment spell|Enchanted]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ether Staff]] and [[Portal Staff]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Ether Staff]] from collectors [[Akom]], [[Behruseh]], or [[Snap Flamekrak]] or crafter [[Ruricu]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Swift]] [[Staff Head]]
*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*[[Ether Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
*Perfect Swift Staff Head
*Perfect Staff Wrapping of Fortitude
*Perfect "Have Faith" [[inscription]]
